title.en: Active Mobility (Exemption for Use of Vehicle on Specified Footpath — Marina Bay) (No. 2) Order 2022

completenessNote: 全文，共 7 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 2 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en:
1.—(1) This Order is the Active Mobility (Exemption for Use of Vehicle on Specified Footpath — Marina Bay) (No. 2) Order 2022.
(2) This Order is in force for the period between 11 July 2022 and 11 July 2029 (both dates inclusive).
[S 578/2024 wef 11/07/2024]
